rows.note: Use 一撻撻 as the all-purpose colloquial choice for irregular patches or spots of colour.

example.english: The wall is mottled and looks really dirty.
example.traditional: 塊牆身一撻撻咁，睇落好污糟。
example.jyutping: faai3 coeng4 san1 jat1 taat3 taat3 gam3 tai2 lok6 hou2 wu1 zou1

rows.note: Use 斑駁 in more written or descriptive contexts, especially for a surface or pattern with contrasting patches of colour.

example.english: The colours on this old wall are mottled and full of character.
example.traditional: 呢幅舊牆嘅顏色斑駁，幾有味道。
example.jyutping: ni1 fuk1 gau6 coeng4 ge3 ngaan4 sik1 baan1 bok3 gei2 jau5 mei6 dou6
